text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Chairwoman... Is it true that you were 
working during yesterday's nap time?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Heart palpitations?! N-No... well, that's, 
um...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorryyy!! Anything but the pigtails 
punishment, pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That's a no-no! We'll make it cute later, 
okay? ...Goodness, what is the matter?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You're already so busy, so even if we have 
to force it, we'll make sure you get your 
rest... We promised that, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I simply wanted to wrap up the 
discussion quickly. Regarding the 
renovation proposal to repair the course 
wear that you noticed.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? ...Are you talking about our chat 
from the other day? But that was merely my 
subjective opinion, just mentioning a 
slight sense of unease...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you sensed something amiss, I 
judged it best to respect your intuition.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I know very well how much care and 
attention you always devote to an 
Umamusume's health... especially her legs.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Taking action quickly will help the 
students, ...and it should put Tazuna at 
ease too.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you for getting back to me. I'm 
so sorry for not noticing sooner. Please, 
let me help out starting right now!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In exchange, no more cutting into your 
days off! ...Your health is something that 
is... very, very important to me, after 
all.
